findings.bio_additions: Waxlife (Simone Lanza) is an Italian electronic music producer and DJ from Malnate/Varese, active since ~2004. His music spans deep house, nu-disco, downtempo, and dance-punk. Released two albums on Ghost Records: Cecilia (2014) and Patterns (2018). Also runs Waxlife Disco Service alias on Trend Records, and archival lo-fi beat releases via Museek Records. Sound designer for fashion brands including Moschino, Max Mara, Valentino, and Diesel. Breakthrough track 'Clocks' (Strictly Groove Recordings) entered Juno Download top 50 nu-disco within a week and was selected by Beatport & iTunes Canada.
